test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The incorrectly spelled word is** "Polution" **which should be spelled as** "Pollution".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pollution** is **the presence or introduction into the environment of substances or things that cause harm or discomfort to living organisms**.
 
• It can be caused by various factors such as industrial activity, transportation, agriculture, and waste disposal.
 
 
• **Examples:** Air pollution caused by emissions from factories and vehicles, water pollution caused by oil spills or chemicals, noise pollution caused by construction or traffic noise, and light pollution caused by excessive artificial lighting.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Correctly spelled words **and their **definitions**:
 
• **Promise **- a commitment to do something or keep a pledge.
 
 
• Example: I **promised **to meet my friend for lunch today.
 
 
 
• **Custom** - a traditional way of behaving or doing something that is specific to a particular society, place, or time.
 
 
• Example: It is a **custom** to exchange gifts during the holiday season.
 
 
 
• **Strength** - the quality or state of being physically or mentally strong.
 
 
• Example: Regular exercise can increase your physical **strength**.
